[[Z'him Monns]] is one of the two boss-like [[Heket]] foes that can be found at the end of the [[Bogroot Growths]] [[dungeon]]; he appears when [[Tekks's War]] is active.

This [[Heket|frogman]] is the leader of the red colored [[Gokir]] fighting a tribal war against the native yellow [[Ophil]] tribe. [[Giriff]] theorizes that Z'him's death would drive the Gokir away from the caves, ending the conflict.

== Notes ==
* When fighting Z'him Monns, spread out to avoid [[Spirit Rift]], which deals [[aoe]] damage at [[spike]] levels.
** For players using mainly [[Hero|heroes]] and [[Henchman|henchmen]], tilt the camera angle to a view that enables quick moves with the [[Hero#Movement|hero controls]] at the first sign of a Spirit Rift.
* If possible, keep him [[dazed]] to prolong survivability.
* The boss room consists of four separate groups, of which Z'him Monns and two [[Gokir Amini]] are part. Pull the remaining three groups one at a time to make it easier to confront the [[Boss-like foe|boss]] himself.
* Defeating him completes [[Tekks's War]] and spawns a [[Bogroot Chest]].

== Trivia ==
*This NPC is a reference to the character [[w:Simmons (Red vs. Blue)|Simmons]] from the online [[w:machinima|machinima]] series [[w:Red vs. blue|Red vs. Blue]].
